title: Garibaldi Leaves Rome
credit: his words as reported in G. M. Trevelyan, Garibaldi's Defence of the Roman Republic (1907), quoted on Wikiquote
licence: Quoted as Wikiquote gives it; the page is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
paras: I offer neither pay, nor quarters, nor provisions; I offer hunger, thirst, forced marches, battles and death. Let him who loves his country in his heart, and not with his lips only, follow me.
